                <p>Our Rating is calculated using information the lawyer has included on
                    their profile in addition to the information we collect from state
                    bar associations and other organizations that license legal
                    professionals. Attorneys who claim their profiles and provide Avvo
                    with more information tend to have a higher rating than those who do
                    not.</p>

                <strong class="h4">Experience & background</strong>
                <p>Years licensed, work experience, education</p>
                <strong class="h4">Legal community recognition</strong>
                <p>Peer endorsements, associations, awards</p>
